title: BoardPacket
description: Board -> engine UDP datagram (BUILD_ORDER §5.5): a full state snapshot, <= 512 bytes, sent on change (<= 60 Hz) and at >= 2 Hz as heartbeat. `mac` must be the LAST member; see board-map.md for the exact bytes it covers.

id.description: Board id; ids starting with 'sim' are board_sim.

boot.description: Random per-boot nonce; seq restarts with it.

e.description: Absolute encoder counts: hue, sat, nudge.

s.description: Toggles: art mode (det/paint/ai), who (auto/board), fader fn (level/hue/sat).
